import numpy as np

t = np.load('npy/shot_table.npz')
print('=== Shot Table Columns ===')
print(list(t.keys()))
print()

ipm2 = t['ipm2']
xray = t['xray']
laser = t['laser']
det_total = t['det_total']
photon_px = t['photon_px']
nswitch = t['nswitch']

N = len(ipm2)
print(f'Total shots: {N}')
print(f'X-ray ON shots:  {int((xray==1).sum())} ({100*(xray==1).mean():.1f}%)')
print(f'X-ray OFF shots: {int((xray==0).sum())} ({100*(xray==0).mean():.1f}%)')
print(f'Laser ON shots:  {int((laser==1).sum())} ({100*(laser==1).mean():.1f}%)')
print()

# IPM2 statistics
print('=== IPM2 (raw, all shots) ===')
print(f'  min={ipm2.min():.2f}, max={ipm2.max():.2f}')
print(f'  mean={ipm2.mean():.2f}, median={np.median(ipm2):.2f}')
print(f'  std={ipm2.std():.2f}')
print()

# Offset estimation
xray_off = ipm2[xray == 0]
offset = float(np.median(xray_off))
print(f'=== IPM2 Zero Offset (median of xray-off) ===')
print(f'  offset = {offset:.4f}')
print(f'  xray-off count: {len(xray_off)}')
print(f'  xray-off ipm2 range: [{xray_off.min():.4f}, {xray_off.max():.4f}]')
print()

# Offset-corrected
ipm2c = ipm2 - offset
xon = xray == 1
ipm2c_on = ipm2c[xon]
print(f'=== IPM2 offset-corrected (xray-on only) ===')
print(f'  min={ipm2c_on.min():.2f}, max={ipm2c_on.max():.2f}')
print(f'  mean={ipm2c_on.mean():.2f}, median={np.median(ipm2c_on):.2f}')
print()

# Low-ipm2 analysis
for thr in [50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 3000]:
    n_below = int((ipm2c_on < thr).sum())
    print(f'  xray-on shots with ipm2c < {thr}: {n_below} ({100*n_below/xon.sum():.1f}%)')

print()

# Percentiles of ipm2 among xray-on
print('=== IPM2 percentiles (xray-on, raw) ===')
for p in [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 95, 99, 99.5, 100]:
    val = np.percentile(ipm2[xon], p)
    print(f'  p{p}: {val:.2f}')
print()

# High-side cut analysis
p99 = np.percentile(ipm2[xon], 99)
n_above_p99 = int((ipm2[xon] > p99).sum())
print(f'=== High-side: shots above p99 ({p99:.2f}) ===')
print(f'  count: {n_above_p99}')
print()

# Photon pixel stats for low vs normal
low_mask = xon & (ipm2c < 200)
normal_mask = xon & (ipm2c >= 200)
print(f'=== Photon Pixels (low <200 vs normal >=200, xray-on) ===')
print(f'  low group: {int(low_mask.sum())} shots, median photon_px = {np.median(photon_px[low_mask]):.1f}')
print(f'  normal group: {int(normal_mask.sum())} shots, median photon_px = {np.median(photon_px[normal_mask]):.1f}')
print()

# Detector total correlation with ipm2 (for normalization evidence)
from numpy import corrcoef
valid = xon & (ipm2c > 200)
r = corrcoef(det_total[valid], ipm2c[valid])[0, 1]
print(f'=== Normalization evidence ===')
print(f'  corr(det_total, ipm2c) for ipm2c>200 xray-on shots: r = {r:.4f}')

# Chronological bin CV test
kept = valid
kept_idx = np.where(kept)[0]
n_kept = len(kept_idx)
n_bins = 8
bin_size = n_kept // n_bins
print(f'  Kept shots for bin test: {n_kept}')
cvs_unnorm = []
cvs_norm = []
bin_totals_unnorm = []
bin_totals_norm = []
for b in range(n_bins):
    start = b * bin_size
    end = (b+1) * bin_size if b < n_bins - 1 else n_kept
    idx = kept_idx[start:end]
    # unnormalized: mean det_total
    bin_totals_unnorm.append(det_total[idx].mean())
    # normalized: mean (det_total / (ipm2c/mean_ipm2c))
    ni = ipm2c[idx] / ipm2c[kept].mean()
    bin_totals_norm.append((det_total[idx] / ni).mean())

cv_unnorm = np.std(bin_totals_unnorm) / np.mean(bin_totals_unnorm) * 100
cv_norm = np.std(bin_totals_norm) / np.mean(bin_totals_norm) * 100
print(f'  Chronological 8-bin CV (unnormalized): {cv_unnorm:.2f}%')
print(f'  Chronological 8-bin CV (normalized):   {cv_norm:.2f}%')
"

input.command:
python3 -c "
import numpy as np

t = np.load('npy/shot_table.npz')
ipm2 = t['ipm2']
xray = t['xray']
det_total = t['det_total']

offset = float(np.median(ipm2[xray == 0]))
ipm2c = ipm2 - offset
xon = xray == 1

print(f'Offset: {offset}')
print()

# ===================== BIN CV TESTS =====================
# Test 1: threshold at 200 (operator hint) -- the setting we'll use
# Test 2: threshold at 3000 (linear plateau) -- for comparison
# In each case, also apply p99 high-side cut per operator hint

p99_raw = np.percentile(ipm2[xon], 99)
print(f'p99 of ipm2 (xray-on, raw): {p99_raw:.2f}')
print()

for label, lo_thr in [('thr=200 (operator hint)', 200), ('thr=3000 (plateau)', 3000)]:
    kept = xon & (ipm2c > lo_thr) & (ipm2 < p99_raw)
    kept_idx = np.where(kept)[0]
    n_kept = len(kept_idx)
    n_bins = 8
    bin_size = n_kept // n_bins
    
    # Chronological bins
    mean_ipm2c_kept = ipm2c[kept].mean()
    
    bin_unnorm = []
    bin_norm_pershot = []
    bin_norm_ros = []
    
    for b in range(n_bins):
        start = b * bin_size
        end = (b+1) * bin_size if b < n_bins - 1 else n_kept
        idx = kept_idx[start:end]
        
        # Unnormalized: mean det_total
        bin_unnorm.append(det_total[idx].mean())
        
        # Per-shot division: each shot's det_total / (ipm2c_i / mean_ipm2c)
        ni = ipm2c[idx] / mean_ipm2c_kept
        bin_norm_pershot.append((det_total[idx] / ni).mean())
        
        # Ratio of sums: sum(det_total) / sum(ipm2c)
        bin_norm_ros.append(det_total[idx].sum() / ipm2c[idx].sum())
    
    cv_unnorm = np.std(bin_unnorm) / np.mean(bin_unnorm) * 100
    cv_pershot = np.std(bin_norm_pershot) / np.mean(bin_norm_pershot) * 100
    cv_ros = np.std(bin_norm_ros) / np.mean(bin_norm_ros) * 100
    
    r = np.corrcoef(det_total[kept], ipm2c[kept])[0, 1]
    
    print(f'=== {label} (n_kept={n_kept}) ===')
    print(f'  corr(det_total, ipm2c): r = {r:.4f}')
    print(f'  8-bin chrono CV (unnormalized):  {cv_unnorm:.2f}%')
    print(f'  8-bin chrono CV (per_shot):      {cv_pershot:.2f}%')
    print(f'  8-bin chrono CV (ratio_of_sums): {cv_ros:.2f}%')
    print()

# ===================== LINEARITY CHECK (det/ipm2 ratio at high end) =====================
print('=== Linearity check: det_total/ipm2c vs ipm2c bins (xray-on, ipm2c>200) ===')
valid = xon & (ipm2c > 200)
ratio = det_total[valid] / ipm2c[valid]
ipm2c_v = ipm2c[valid]
# Bin by ipm2c deciles
edges = np.percentile(ipm2c_v, np.arange(0, 101, 10))
for i in range(10):
    lo, hi = edges[i], edges[i+1]
    mask = (ipm2c_v >= lo) & (ipm2c_v < hi) if i < 9 else (ipm2c_v >= lo)
    if mask.sum() > 0:
        print(f'  Decile {i+1} (ipm2c {lo:.0f}-{hi:.0f}): mean ratio = {ratio[mask].mean():.6f}, n={mask.sum()}')

# ===================== nswitch check for bright shots =====================
print()
print('=== Gain-mode switching (nswitch) for brightest shots ===')
nswitch = t['nswitch']
bright = xon & (ipm2 > p99_raw)
normal_sample = xon & (ipm2c > 200) & (ipm2 < p99_raw)
print(f'  Bright (>p99): median nswitch = {np.median(nswitch[bright]):.0f}, mean = {nswitch[bright].mean():.1f}')
print(f'  Normal sample: median nswitch = {np.median(nswitch[normal_sample]):.0f}, mean = {nswitch[normal_sample].mean():.1f}')
"
